title: Rau Krzysztof
name: Rau Krzysztof
description: composer; b. 21st November 1995 in Białystok. A graduate and PhD student at the Karol Lipiński Academy of Music in Wrocław in the composition class of Agata Zubel-Moc and Marcin Rupociński. He participated in workshops and master classes with, among others, Ondreż Adamek, Marta Ptaszyńska, Mauricio Sotelo, Johannes Kreidler, Marcin Stańczyk and Conrado Xalabarder. He is a scholarship holder of the Minister of Culture and National Heritage. His works were performed in Poland and abroad, among others in Sweden, Belgium and the Netherlands, at various international festivals such as Saxå Kammarmusikfestival, Klarafestival, Wonderfell, and Musica Electronica Nova. He took part in the international Music Master of Air project, organized by the European Festivals Association and co-organized by the National Forum of Music, and in many theater and audiovisual projects of the Academy of Theatre Arts in Wrocław as well as the Academy of Fine Arts in Wrocław. updated: 2020 (ac)
